zh.text: @TheTranscript_ 分享 $JPM JPMorgan Chase 高管 Charles Bristow：AI 驅動的存款流動性最終可能通過削弱銀行資助長期貸款的能力而提高全經濟體的借貸成本。指出存款速度越高，對期限資產的需求越少。

en.text: @TheTranscript_ shares $JPM JPMorgan Chase Executive Charles Bristow: AI-driven deposit mobility could ultimately raise economy-wide borrowing costs by undermining banks' ability to fund long-term loans. Notes higher velocity in deposits means less demand for duration-bearing assets.

zh.text: 烏克蘭通臀為 10.0%/年，高於其 5.0%/年目標。烏克蘭貨幣供應量（M3）以 14.6%/年增長，高於 Hanke 的黃金增長率 9.3%/年，該比率與 5%/年通臀目標一致。通臀故事 = 貨幣供應。

en.text: Ukraine's inflation came in at 10.0%/yr. That's ABOVE its target of 5.0%/yr. Ukraine's money supply (M3) is growing at 14.6%/yr, ABOVE Hanke's Golden Growth Rate of 9.3%/yr, a rate consistent with Ukraine's inflation target of 5%/yr. THE INFLATION STORY = A MONEY SUPPLY.
